seoTitle: 👇 Backhand Index Pointing Down Emoji Meaning
seoDescription: Learn what the Backhand Index Pointing Down emoji 👇 really means.

longForm.overview:
The 👇 Backhand Index Pointing Down emoji was added in Unicode 6 (2010) and is drawn as a yellow hand with the back of the hand showing and the index finger pointing downward. The visual cue reads instantly as 'look below,' direction, or the visible 'over there' tag. By 2026 👇 has become the go-to emoji for the attention-directing tag below, the visible 'see this' default, and the link-coded reference.

In modern chat 👇 does very specific work. People send it as a literal down-direction tag, as the visible 'see below' marker, or as the link-coded-reference shorthand. The pointing-backhand-index-finger-down is the visual cue that the message is directing attention downward. Writers should pick 👇 when the read is 'see below' or 'check the link,' and avoid it when the read is different — ☝️ fits better for literal up-pointing.
longForm.howPeopleUseIt:
👇 lands on a friend's 'check this link' message, in a work channel where someone is directing attention to a thread or document below, and in a dating-app DM where the sender is referencing content. The pointing-backhand-index-finger-down anchors the read.

In close-friends chats 👇 reads as the universal 'see below' tag and the pointing-down default. On X the emoji punctuates 'see thread below' coded tweets. The emoji pairs with 👆 for the layered up-and-down pointing pair and with 🔗 for the link-coded reference combo.
longForm.whenNotToUse: Skip 👇 in any context where the direction is up — ☝️ fits better. Avoid 👇 in ironic contexts where the pointing is faked — 🙄 fits better when the attention-directing is performed.
longForm.howToReply:
If a friend sends 👇 on a 'see below' message, mirror with a sentence that engages what they pointed to. The pointing chain needs an audience.

If 👇 lands as the link-reference default, reply with a sentence that engages the content. And if you want to send 👇 yourself, pair it with the subject so the direction is clear.

faqs.question: What does 👇 mean in text?
faqs.answer: 👇 means 'see below,' 'check this link,' or down-direction. The pointing-backhand-index-finger-down is the visual cue that the message is directing attention downward.

faqs.question: Is 👇 a flirty emoji?
faqs.answer: Not on its own. 👇 is the see-below default. In a flirty thread combined with 👆 it can read as 'look down here' but it is not a love signal.

faqs.question: What does 👇 mean from a guy?
faqs.answer: From a guy or anyone, 👇 carries the same see-below read. There is no gendered meaning; the emoji works the same regardless.

faqs.question: What does 👇 mean at work?
faqs.answer: In Slack, 👇 reads as the 'see thread below' tag. Pair with a sentence about the content so the channel stays useful.
